data.body: **[P2] Keep retained-size traversal itself bounded.** `gc.get_referents()` materializes every referent before the cap is checked again. A container subclass can under-report `__sizeof__` while holding millions of elements, causing a large referent list and traversal stack to be allocated on the checkpoint thread before saturation. Traverse known containers incrementally using base-type access and reject or short-circuit unsupported variable-fanout objects; test a large container subclass with an under-reporting `__sizeof__`.
